input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The agreement imposes no minimum purchase, take-or-pay or volume commitment on AP. Services are provided per individual Exhibit on a "specific engagement by Customer" basis (p0001), and the sole economic term is a revenue share of amounts actually generated, with Kubient paying AP within seven days of receipt (p0023) — i.e., no committed spend or shortfall/penalty mechanic. The agreement is also expressly non-exclusive and does not restrict AP from selling Inventory through other agents or third parties, so there is no volume cap or channel restriction on us. This meets the preferred position (no minimum commitment; fees for usage or ordered services only). Searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall" and "take or pay" surfaced only the Winning Bid Price floor set by AP (p0001/p0014) and the mutual material-breach termination right (p0016), neither of which is a purchase commitment. Noted but not flagged under this rule: neither party may terminate during the one-year Initial Term except for breach, and Kubient is entitled to fees generated during any termination notice period — a term/exit point rather than a take-or-pay commitment. Any future Exhibit should be checked for minimum volume or spend language.
